Dear Residents,
It has been an honor to serve you as Councilmember and Mayor Pro Tem. Please accept my deepest appreciation. I seek your Vote for a second term to bring to fruition many important projects that begun under my watch since 2022. Last year, we opened our Navigation Center to provide much needed shelter. This September, our Public Safety Building will be inaugurated. We wrap-up our fiscal year with a balanced budget while the State of our City remains Strong. I have been a constant advocate for Immigrant Rights as we navigate policy challenges. I have promoted development of multiple communities. I’m always reminding our development partners of building with an eye for affordable housing and honoring our commitment to hire locally and respect labor contracts. I have supported our employees and city staff as we renew their contracts in-line with inflation and increased needs. I stand with our residents to demand accountability, transparency and responsibility in times of crises as exemplified in the case of GKN chemical tank crisis. I vow to double my efforts to serve you even better in the next term.

Joe DoVinh
Garden Grove Council Member

text: My education, experience, and commitment to Garden Grove, where my family has lived since 1974, have prepared me to bring innovative, practical solutions to District 4. As a Mechanical Engineering graduate student at Johns Hopkins University and an Astrophysics graduate from the UC Santa Cruz, I have built my career on analyzing complex problems, designing efficient systems, and delivering results through research and collaboration. My experience developing advanced aerospace instrumentation, conducting scientific research, and leading engineering projects has strengthened my ability to evaluate data, manage resources responsibly, and make informed decisions. These skills translate to improving city infrastructure, creating a faster, more reliable, and more affordable public transportation system that gives residents mobility while reducing dependence on rising gas costs. I am equally committed to establishing a no-kill humane society that protects companion animals while lowering long-term animal care costs through efficient operations, partnerships, and responsible planning. I also believe every resident deserves safe neighborhoods, clean streets, and responsive local government that listens to the community. I will apply the same analytical thinking, fiscal responsibility, and dedication that have guided my academic and professional achievements to help build a safer, more compassionate, and more prosperous Garden Grove for everyone.

text: Garden Grove gave my family the opportunity to get ahead, and now I’m running for City Council to help Garden Grove grow forward.

As a Councilmember, I will fight to make life more affordable, address homelessness, strengthen city services, expand parks and open space for children and families, and invest in community programs that bring residents together.

I immigrated here from Vietnam as a child and attended Garden Grove public schools. My family worked long hours in local garment factories, and like many working families, we relied on programs like Medi-Cal, SNAP, and Section 8 to get by. Those experiences taught me the value of hard work, resilience, and community.

For nearly 20 years, I’ve spent my career as a social worker, community organizer, small business owner, and healthcare leader. I’ve worked directly with people experiencing homelessness, mental health, and substance use issues while bringing together local leaders and community organizations to solve problems and strengthen the services families rely on.

Today, I’m proudly raising my son in the same neighborhood where I grew up. I’m ready to help build a stronger, more affordable, and connected Garden Grove for every resident. I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Garden Grove has been my family’s home for more than 40 years. As your City Councilmember from 2014 to 2022, I worked every day to protect our neighborhoods, support local businesses, and serve our community with integrity. I am asking for your vote to continue that commitment.
As a business owner, CEO, former Planning Commissioner, and current Orange County Housing and Community Development Commissioner, I have the experience to deliver results from day one.

My top priority is public safety. I will work to fully staff our Police Department, support our officers, enforce city laws to remove illegal homeless encampments from our parks, neighborhoods, and business districts, and hold homeless programs accountable for measurable results. I will support local businesses by reducing unnecessary regulations, oppose new taxes and fee increases, modernize City Hall to improve efficiency and customer service and ensure taxpayer dollars are spent wisely, responsibly, and transparently.

As a refugee who came to America with nothing, I have never forgotten the opportunities Garden Grove gave my family. Public service is my way of giving back to the community that has given us so much.
I'm endorsed by Orange County Supervisor Janet Nguyen and Garden Grove Mayor Stephanie Klopfenstein, and respectfully ask for your vote.
